represents: About 50 minutes of API-server audit traffic from the control plane of a 9-node kubeadm v1.30 cluster (kube-proxy + Cilium, CoreDNS): kubelet heartbeats, node and pod status, projected-token refreshes and Secret-volume watches; kube-controller-manager and kube-scheduler leader election; the per-controller service accounts (replicaset, deployment, daemon-set, job, cronjob, ttl-after-finished, garbage collector, endpointslice, HPA, root-ca publisher) creating and deleting pods, Jobs and EndpointSlices; add-on controller leases; coredns/kube-proxy/cilium reads and writes; and, at low weight, a control-plane kubelet restart that re-registers its four static-pod mirror pods and DaemonSet rollouts of node agents.
provenance: synthetic; event shapes from the audit.k8s.io/v1 Event type and kube-apiserver audit behaviour (one event per request, RequestReceived omitted), levels per detections/k8s/audit-policy-apiserver.yaml (Request for pods/workloads/RBAC/admission/DNS ConfigMaps, Metadata for secrets and serviceaccounts/token, reads of endpoints/events/leases/configmaps/status dropped), identities and user agents per kubeadm defaults (--use-service-account-credentials, node authorizer, system:node:<name>), request bodies per the core/v1, apps/v1 and batch/v1 types as the controllers send them (defaulted templates, no admission-injected token volume). Version strings and build hashes are illustrative; addresses are RFC1918; names are fictional. Cross-event sequences are not modelled (each event is drawn independently).
adjacent_to: T1543.005/k8s_static_pod_mirror_create.yml (kubelet mirror-pod creates for kubeadm static pods)
T1611/k8s_podspec_host_access.yml (DaemonSet node agents and static pods with hostNetwork/hostPath/privileged)
